description: Encodes an ASN.1 value string into hex or base64 encoded binary data according to the provided schema definition, ASN.1 type name, and encoding rule (DER by default).

codec.description: The ASN.1 encoding rule to use for encoding. Valid options include 'DER', 'BER', 'PER', 'UPER' or 'CUPER', 'OER' or 'COER', 'JER', 'XML or 'XER' or 'EXER'. Defaults to 'DER'.

dataFormat.description: Desired format of the output encoded data: 'hex' or 'base64'. Defaults to 'hex'.

fileName.description: The name of the schema file. This should end in '.asn' (e.g., 'Rocket.asn'). If not provided, defaults to 'schema.asn'.

schemaContent.description: Plain-text ASN.1 schema definition. This must be valid ASN.1 syntax, typically starting with the 'DEFINITIONS' keyword and concluding with 'END'.

typeName.description: The ASN.1 type name (PDU) to encode (e.g., 'Rocket').

userId.description: The user's email address to look up the asn1.io user account. If unknown, pass an empty string.

value.description: The ASN.1 value string to be encoded (e.g., in ASN.1 value notation).

name: encode_asn1_data
